notes: Cases from the order's Case column show their ID, big (308, 360, HAMPER-2…) in the truck, with the order's Case Contents text (what prints in the case label's CONT box) under it, instead of the first thing inside. Gear that is its own case (a kart, SLS) still shows its name. The CONT text needs BSI Link updated. A case the order lists as a line of its own and names in its Case column (a "27" line, then cables in 27) is one case holding both, instead of "listed twice". Import Cases… reads a Tips onto column (never, side, end or any), the way the case editor says it. "Never" is this side up.…
